unknown command: --help

usage: imd <command> [options]

  start        run the worker (--runtime claude|codex, --concurrency 1-4, --server URL, --auto-update)
  service      install|restart|status|logs|start|stop|uninstall the user service
  pair         pair this machine with an Identity.md token
  status       show configuration, runtimes and server eligibility
  doctor       check the machine end to end and ask the network why it is or is not offered work
  unlink       release the pairing
  whoami       print this device's public key
  site         publish|status|names
  skills       list|remove|off|add <id>
  tools        list|add|key|forget|remove
  update       install the latest release
